summary: Iteration 50: Comprehensive testing of Dispatch Terminal feature. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Dispatch Admin dashboard with all 5 tabs (Overview, Pending, Porter Settlement, Employees, Updates) working correctly. Dispatch role properly integrated in auth system and user creation form.

dispatch_cards_api.GET /api/dispatch/cards?status=active: PASS - Returns dispatch cards list with total count
dispatch_cards_api.POST /api/dispatch/cards: PASS - Creates manual dispatch card with MAN- prefix
dispatch_cards_api.PATCH /api/dispatch/cards/{card_id}: PASS - Updates card fields (boxes, transport, porter, LR number)
dispatch_cards_api.PATCH /api/dispatch/cards/{card_id}/stat: PASS - Transitions card status with validation

auto_create_api.POST /api/dispatch/auto-create: PASS - Creates cards from sales invoices

porter_management_api.POST /api/dispatch/porters: PASS - Creates porter with PRT- prefix

dispatch_role_auth.dispatch_role_in_user_creation: PASS - Dispatch role available in POST /api/auth/users

frontend_dispatch_admin.overview_tab: PASS - Shows dispatched today, pending, hold counts, transport/porter charges
frontend_dispatch_admin.pending_tab: PASS - Shows 199 pending cards with status badges and reassign buttons
frontend_dispatch_admin.porter_settlement_tab: PASS - Shows porter table with charges, paid, balance due
frontend_dispatch_admin.employees_tab: PASS - Shows message to add dispatch role users via Setup
frontend_dispatch_admin.updates_tab: PASS - Shows 6 changelog entries including Dispatch Terminal launch

frontend_role_selector.dispatch_role_in_employee_form: PASS - Role selector in ProfileModal has 'Dispatch (Terminal Only)' option

critical_code_review_comments: Dispatch feature is well-implemented with proper status lifecycle (NEW->QUEUED->PROCESSING->PACKED->DISPATCHED->INFO_SHARED+HOLD)
Physical check validation enforced before marking as packed
Porter settlement correctly calculates charges, payments, and balance due
Round-robin assignment of dispatch cards to dispatch employees implemented
Dispatch role properly integrated in auth system with feature gating

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All tabs and features verified via Playwright)

seed_data_creation: Created test dispatch cards, porters, and porter payments with TEST_DISPATCH_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 50 verified complete Dispatch Terminal feature: 1) All 21 backend API tests pass. 2) Frontend Dispatch Admin dashboard works with all 5 tabs. 3) 1272 pending dispatch cards exist. 4) Porter 'Raju Porter' has Rs.-300 balance (overpaid). 5) Dispatch role available in user creation form. 6) Login requires reCAPTCHA - use token injection via localStorage for automated testing.
